runtime_prompt_en:
Create a photorealistic mainstream swimwear campaign featuring a clearly adult original K-pop-idol-inspired woman in her mid-twenties. The casting remains an original adult fashion model. She has luminous porcelain-pale skin, long glossy dark hair, and a slender athletic silhouette. She wears a sleek one-piece swimsuit in opaque matte fabric. The swimsuit is deep navy blue with wide straps and a full-coverage cut. At a bright ocean waterline, she stands barefoot in a three-quarter rear view, her torso angled about 45 degrees away from the camera. Frame her full figure from a restrained low camera position behind and slightly to one side. Her legs stay adducted with the knees close. The actual upper inner-thigh contours create clean opposing boundaries; a narrow background opening remains visible between them, forming a readable thigh gap with believable anatomy. The appealing focal geometry stays subtle within the full figure; the opening is anatomical negative space, not shadow. Keep it readable at thumbnail scale. Warm late-afternoon sunlight traces her hair, shoulders, and legs; gentle surf, pale sand, and a clean horizon create polished contemporary K-pop editorial styling.

Avoid: plastic-looking skin, broken facial features, fake-looking background, over-processed retouching, cartoon style, excessive HDR, 3D render look, low resolution, distorted fingers
